name: source-layout-decisions
body:
The source layout: src/lib.rs owns the module tree, and src/main.rs is a thin binary — the prerequisite for the e2e tests living outside the module tree.

e2e tests: the e2e tests live in per-source-module files at the top level (tests/main_e2e.rs, tests/plan_cmd_e2e.rs, …), sharing a tests/common/mod.rs helper module.

unit + int tests: each source module's tests live in a sibling module file (e.g. src/plan_cmd/tests.rs via #[cfg(test)] mod tests;), preserving module paths so the …::tests::unit:: and …::tests::int:: filters select a tier.

Decomposition over size: modules are cohesive and single-responsibility, and shared logic is single-sourced; a ~400-line file is a signal for review, and splitting a file to hit a number while leaving cohesion unchanged is itself a defect. Scope is repo-wide first-party source (root crate plus eight frontend crates), excluding vendored (src/cpplib/vendor/**) and testdata (testdata/**).

Behaviour-preserving: the layout carries zero behaviour change, and the existing suite is the proof. FQNs in this spec are the branch graph's language-rooted identities (rust.apg.*), matching the durable spec; the cargo aliases in .cargo/config.toml are libtest path filters and travel with the layout.
